name: ADVO public surface brief
body:
# ADVO brand brief — {{surface_name}}

Direction: serious monotone. Software plus hardware, treated like Runway robotics. Not friendly campus UI.

## Canvas and chrome
- Canvas `#0C0C0C` or inverted white `#FFFFFF`. Ink `#0C0C0C`, soft ink `#6B7280`, mute `#9A9AA0`, hairline `#E5E7EB`, ghost `#EEF1F5`, dark CTA `#262626`, deep `#000000`.
- Chrome is a 1px hairline. No glass, no blur, no shadow, no gradient mesh. The one gradient allowed is the edge fade on a logo strip.
- Colour lives only inside the stills or a film ({{primary_still}}), never behind type.
- Radius 6px on controls, 12–16px on media frames and cards.

## Type
- Instrument Sans, weight 400 on headlines, tight tracking (-0.02em display, -0.015em titles).
- Seven steps: 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 22 / clamp(28–40) / clamp(34–46). No one-off sizes.
- Mono uppercase micro-labels only where a Figure/Anduril-style frame wants one; the landing hero carries none.

## Motion
- Fade-up 16px once on entry (0.5s, ease [0.32, 0.72, 0, 1]). Hero copy staggers 0.1s. Stills drift ≤14% on scroll.
- Buttons press to 96% and darken on hover. Cross-fade between panels in 0.3–0.45s.
- The client strip is an infinite marquee, 42s per pass.

## Icons and marks
- Lucide at `strokeWidth={1}` with `absoluteStrokeWidth`; Tabler at `stroke={1}`.
- The wordmark is the traced lockup `public/advo-wordmark.svg`, set to the column width through a CSS mask on dark, plain on light. Never typed in the body face.
- Client marks in grayscale on the strip.

## Copy
- Headline: {{headline}}. Primary CTA: {{cta_label}}. Sentences end. No kicker-plus-heading-plus-blurb stacks. No isometric clip-art, no generated illustrations.

## Reference map
- runway.com and /product/robotics: product chrome, rounded hero frame, hairline cards.
- vercel.com: the nav pair (hairline outline beside solid black). Not the mesh.
- anduril.com, figure.ai, 1x.tech: full-bleed film framing, copy pinned low.
- Dribbble lockups (Monvera, DealMover, Nexora, Menbun, Garlic, Frontseat): wordmark plus monogram anatomy, black on white.
- Out: Linear, Anthropic ivory, OpenAI pastels, OrionX cyan, Apptronik orange, pill buttons.

## Gate
`npm run bench:visual` asserts no-glass, no-shadow, icons-stroke-one, one-gradient, a bounded type scale, tokenised colour, and the section-rhythm token.
